name: Tiagra press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 71 g for the BB-RS500-PB HOLLOWTECH II press-fit assembly for an 86.5 mm shell. The handbook explicitly identifies BB-RS500-PB in the 86.5 mm press-fit row under its BB-RS500-P heading.
